Keys: 'note' (HTML, appended to the description), 'perm' (name of the Project Settings permission the row needs, see EngineApi.cpp perm::allowed), 'script_sig' / 'script_returns' (the Lua/Python call when it differs from the registry signature), 'examples' ({lua, python} source, rendered with the language switcher). Steps 3-8 of Thema 79 fill this per group.
